headline: Agreed to a second meeting on the school budget; FY 2027 expenses review deferred to a future meeting.
summary: Officials reviewed FY 2026 results, which showed revenue and expenses producing +898,817 against budget, and the unaudited fund balance as of 6/30/2026. The superintendent accepted responsibility for the district's reporting failures, and the FY 2027 revised revenue was amended to $65,421,429. Public comments followed, and the FY 2027 expenses review will be heard at a later meeting.
decisions: Approved a second meeting with the School Department and School Committee; all members agreed.
Continued the FY 27 revised expenses review and five-year capital plan to a future meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Before the meeting is completed, Town Council members request a second meeting with the School Department and School Committee. All members are in agreement.

The following items are not reviewed and will be heard at a future meeting: FY 27 Revised Expenses: Total & Staffing; FY 27 Revised Expenses: Non-Staffing and Capital Improvement Plan - FY 27 and Recommended Five-Year Plan.
